These eight project-specific models originate from the project's recorded
text requests, without third-party image or model reference inputs.
Local derivatives include coordinate/scale normalization, triangulation,
LOD generation, PBR texture conversion and Unreal import. Starter hulls
also have selection collision and a local faction-tint material binding.
The provider source GLBs are retained unchanged in the project workspace.
No new rights are asserted for the separate local-only third-party imports.
